basic_info.description: In a city where the extraordinary hides in plain sight, few homes capture the imagination quite like this serene flat on Walter Street. Nestled on a quiet, tree-lined block in the heart of Duboce Triangle, this 2BD/1BA full-floor flat in a classical three-unit Edwardian building is a timeless blend of classic San Francisco elegance and modern ease. Behind the charming faade of a boutique building, you'll discover a home that balances light, space, and historic details with effortless sophistication. The gracious living room, adorned with bay windows and a fireplace, invites you in with its old-world charm, while the generous layout unfolds into a flexible floor plan designed for comfort and creativity. Soaring ceilings and refined finishes add depth to every corner, from the clawfoot tub and separate shower in the beautifully appointed bath to the spacious dining room overlooking a tranquil shared garden. A bonus room at the rear offers direct access to the shared tranquil garden and a quiet space to recharge. Outside your door, Duboce Park, eclectic shops, cozy cafs, the lively Castro District, and world-class transit connect you to the pulse of the city, yet you remain wrapped in a rare and peaceful stillness. Why choose between location and lifestyle when you can have both?
